name: herdr-progressive-reviewer
description: The Claude Code plugin of the progressive reviewer, a Herdr plugin.

plugins.name: progressive-reviewer
plugins.description: Tells the progressive reviewer what the agent in its pane of Herdr, or its terminal of herdr-core, does. A prompt of the reviewer's Explore round, Implement or Post review that names a model and an effort on a line of its own puts the session's main loop on them until the process ends or a later round names others.
